title.description: Chart title displayed above the visualization

stacked.description: Stack mode: 'standard' stacks bars/areas; 'percentage' normalises each column to 100%; omit or 'none' for grouped

xAxisMode.description: X-axis scale: 'date' for time-series data with date/datetime columns (enables proper time axis spacing); 'category' (default) for categorical labels

missingData.description: How to handle missing data points on time-series: 'lineToZero' (default, null→0), 'breaks' (gap in line), 'linearInterpolation' (connect across gap)

numberOfPoints.description: Cap the chart to the last N data points (useful to limit dense time-series to e.g. last 30 days)

indexAxis.description: Set to 'y' for horizontal bar charts (use for 8+ categories or long labels)

showLegend.description: Show chart legend (hide on single-dataset charts)

sortBy.description: Sort bars by label or value (always 'none' for time-series / date axis)

roundValues.description: Round displayed data labels to fixed decimal places

decimalPlaces.description: Decimal places for rounding displayed values (default: 2)

yAxisRight.description: Right Y-axis overrides — only needed for dual-axis combo charts where a second series uses yAxisID 'right'

alignBothAxesToZero.description: Force both Y-axes to start at 0 (dual-axis only)

labelColumn.description: Column for x-axis labels or pie slice names. Required for all chart types except scatter with xMetricColumn/yMetricColumn

datasetColumns.description: Array of dataset series objects. Required for non-scatter charts. Each item: {column, label, aggregation?, seriesType?, yAxisID?}

xMetricColumn.description: Scatter only: column for the X-axis metric. Use this instead of datasetColumns for scatter charts

yMetricColumn.description: Scatter only: column for the Y-axis metric

chartType.description: Must match config.type (e.g. 'scatter') — required when using legacy (X)/(Y) scatter via datasetColumns
